about: The Gate 3 board's own words and the files it reads. Every number, picture and teammate's word on the board is read from the files under slots at build time by work/build/scripts/phase-3/gate_3_board_build.py. Written by the board builder (oa-design-director as page builder), November 20, 2026.
title: Edition 06 Gate 3

cover.title: Chapters 13 to 15 and the plan for Phase 4
deck: Phase 3 built chapters 13, 14 and 15 with the chart kit behind them, and this gate’s pass applied your {n_answers} answers on board 3.

Panel 1 asks for your word on {n_decisions_w} decisions and {n_questions_w} questions about Phase 4, each with the studio’s recommendation. clearance.title: The label clearance list

clearance.before_lede: Before S59 took its setting, the same test found one chart, S59, whose “4.1” a band edge crossed at {count} widths. The setting moved that one word, at those widths only.
